versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this version.

- Version number remains at 1.0.2 in SKILL.md.
- No file changes or updates were made.

- Improved investor identification and sourcing for any country, ensuring every field includes the source and completeness rating.
- Strictly separates genuine investors from advisers and does not merge firms without clear evidence.
- Progress is always saved; a second run continues gathering data instead of repeating previous steps.
- Results are consistently delivered as a single Excel file, summarizing all found investors and sources.
- Transparent about partial results if the full memory can’t be accessed, avoiding claims of completeness it cannot prove.
